description: This file declares APIs and data structures for managing XHosts objects within a COSA Data Model Library, including functions for retrieving, setting, validating, and committing host-related parameters and their IP address entries.

methods.name: XHosts_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG type parameter value for the XHosts object.

methods.name: XHost_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of host entries.

methods.name: XHost_GetEntry
methods.description: Fetches a specific host entry based on index.

methods.name: XHost_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the host data under a given context has been updated.

methods.name: XHost_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes host data for a given context.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for a specific host.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for a specific host.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for a specific host.

methods.name: XHost_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for a specific host.

methods.name: XHost_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a specific host.

methods.name: XHost_Validate
methods.description: Validates host parameters before committing changes.

methods.name: XHost_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes made to the host data.

methods.name: XHost_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back any uncommitted changes to host data.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of IPv4 addresses associated with a host.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetEntry
methods.description: Fetches a specific IPv4 address entry for a host.

methods.name: XHost_IPv4Address_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter (IPv4 address) for a specific IPv4 address entry.

methods.name: XHost_IPv6Address_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of IPv6 addresses associated with a host.

methods.name: XHost_IPv6Address_GetEntry
methods.description: Fetches a specific IPv6 address entry for a host.

methods.name: XHost_IPv6Address_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter (IPv6 address) for a specific IPv6 address entry.
